The evidence does not indicate a clear decline in Romanian card usage.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"Romania card spend per active user","baseline_value":316.794836,"anomaly_value":312.602723,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT AVG(spend_per_active) for Romania months Jan 2025–Feb 2026 and May 2026 spend_per_active from fct_activity_monthly joined to dim_users; see returned result."},{"name":"Romania card spend per active user, March–May 2026 change","baseline_value":319.548121,"anomaly_value":312.602723,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT monthly SUM(card_spend_eur)/COUNT(DISTINCT active user_id) for Romania, March and May 2026, from fct_activity_monthly joined to dim_users."},{"name":"Romania card spend per active user, baseline monthly standard deviation","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":21.816836,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(monthly spend_per_active) for Romania, Jan 2025–Feb 2026, from fct_activity_monthly joined to dim_users."},{"name":"Romania card transactions per active user","baseline_value":11.947109,"anomaly_value":11.793446,"unit":"transactions/user","sql":"SELECT monthly SUM(n_card_txns)/COUNT(DISTINCT active user_id) for Romania, March and May 2026, from fct_activity_monthly joined to dim_users."}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Spend per active user fell from €319.55 in March to €312.60 in May 2026, about 2.2%; May is also close to the €316.79 average across Jan 2025–Feb 2026 and well within the historical monthly standard deviation of €21.82. Transactions per active user dipped only from 11.95 to 11.79 over the same period. This does not establish a meaningful decline in Romanian card usage."}
